{{Quote|Hey, what do I look like? An Imperial stormtrooper? I mind my own business, and I don't care what anyone else does.|Garrick|<ref name="marvel81" />}}
'''Garrick''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="marvel81" /> who worked as the chief traffic controller<ref name="cswe">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> at [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Garrick was in charge of clearing or denying landing to incoming [[Starship/Legends|ships]]&mdash;Garrick had a special dislike for [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who had in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] skipped out on docking fees<ref name="marvel81" /> to transport a [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|pair of]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|passengers]] to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="cswe" />

When Solo returned to Tatooine shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Garrick attempted to deny Solo's ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'' a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]], although he was overridden due to Solo's companion [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] possessing priority diplomatic clearance. Shortly afterward, fearing that local [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]]&mdash;emboldened by the recent downfall of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal outfit]]&mdash;had stolen their [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], Solo attempted to question Garrick while he was repairing a pair of [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]]. When Garrick brushed off his questions, Solo physically attacked the man and stole the landspeeders for himself and Organa, taking off after the Jawas.<ref name="marvel81" />
